The puck has a mind of its own, goalies are getting caught out of position, and Weird NHL is back with another collection of moments that make absolutely no sense!
In Vol. 143, Zack MacEwen scores an unbelievable goal involving a flying stick, Drake Batherson completes a hat trick by blocking a shot into an empty net, and the Winnipeg Jets pull off a historic four-goal comeback against the Montreal Canadiens!
